title: Indian Coast Guard Navik & Yantrik Guide: Selection Stages, PFT & Syllabus
summary: Step-by-step roadmap to join the Indian Coast Guard as Navik General Duty (GD), Navik Domestic Branch (DB), or Yantrik (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics).
author: Sarkari Aavedan Editorial Team
content:
## Introduction

The Indian Coast Guard (ICG), an armed force of the Union operating under the Ministry of Defence, protects India's maritime zones, prevents maritime smuggling, conducts search and rescue missions at sea, and safeguards marine ecology. Recruitment for **Navik (General Duty), Navik (Domestic Branch), and Yantrik** offers adventurous sea-going careers with excellent accommodation, allowances, medical benefits, and promotion ladders.

## Entry Branches & Eligibility Criteria

| Branch / Post | Educational Qualification | Technical Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| **Navik (General Duty - GD)** | 10+2 passed with **Maths and Physics** from an education board recognized by Council of Boards for School Education (COBSE). | 10+2 with Science stream mandatory. |
| **Navik (Domestic Branch - DB)** | 10th Class passed from an education board recognized by COBSE. | Simple 10th pass qualification. Handles Cook and Steward duties on board ships. |
| **Yantrik (Mechanical)** | 10th Class passed AND 3/4-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering approved by AICTE. | Lateral entry diploma holders also eligible. |
| **Yantrik (Electrical)** | 10th Class passed AND 3/4-year Diploma in Electrical Engineering approved by AICTE. | Lateral entry diploma holders also eligible. |
| **Yantrik (Electronics/Telecomm)** | 10th Class passed AND 3/4-year Diploma in Electronics / Telecommunication / Instrumentation approved by AICTE. | Lateral entry diploma holders also eligible. |

## Age Limit & Relaxations

| Category | Permissible Age Limit | Upper Age Relaxation |
|---|---|---|
| **General / EWS** | 18 - 22 Years | Nil (0 Years) |
| **OBC (Non-Creamy Layer)** | 18 - 22 Years | 3 Years (Up to 25 Years) |
| **SC / ST** | 18 - 22 Years | 5 Years (Up to 27 Years) |
| **Candidate Gender** | Men Only (For Navik & Yantrik sailor cadres) | Unmarried Male Indian Citizens |

## Selection Architecture (4 Stages)

### Stage-I: Computer Based Online Examination
| Post Applied | Written Exam Sections Required | Pass Criteria |
|---|---|---|
| **Navik (DB)** | Section I Only | Passing in Section I mandatory |
| **Navik (GD)** | Section I + Section II | Passing in both Section I and Section II separately is mandatory |
| **Yantrik (Mechanical)** | Section I + Section III | Passing in both Section I and Section III separately is mandatory |
| **Yantrik (Electrical)** | Section I + Section IV | Passing in both Section I and Section IV separately is mandatory |
| **Yantrik (Electronics)** | Section I + Section V | Passing in both Section I and Section V separately is mandatory |

### Section-Wise Exam Breakdown
| Section | Subjects Covered | Questions | Marks | Time Duration |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Section I** | Maths (20), Science (10), English (15), Reasoning (10), GK (5) | 60 Questions | 60 Marks | 45 Minutes (No negative marking) |
| **Section II** | Maths (25) + Physics (25) (Class 12 CBSE Syllabus) | 50 Questions | 50 Marks | 30 Minutes (No negative marking) |
| **Section III** | Engineering Diploma Mechanical Core Subject | 50 Questions | 50 Marks | 30 Minutes (No negative marking) |
| **Section IV** | Engineering Diploma Electrical Core Subject | 50 Questions | 50 Marks | 30 Minutes (No negative marking) |
| **Section V** | Engineering Diploma Electronics Core Subject | 50 Questions | 50 Marks | 30 Minutes (No negative marking) |

### Stage-II: Physical Fitness Test (PFT) & Adaptability Test
- **1.6 km Run:** To be completed in **7 minutes** continuously.
- **Squat Ups (Uthak Baithak):** **20 Squat-ups** continuously.
- **Push-ups:** **10 Push-ups** continuously.
- All three tests are conducted without break and are qualifying in nature.

### Stage-III & IV: Document Verification & Final Medicals at INS Chilka
- Final document verification and comprehensive medical examination conducted at the premier naval training establishment INS Chilka prior to induction.

## Actionable Preparation Strategy

| Phase | Focus Area & Regimen |
|---|---|
| **Phase 1: Class 12 Physics & Maths (For Navik GD)** | Focus heavily on NCERT Class 11 and 12 Calculus, Vectors, Trigonometry, Coordinate Geometry, Mechanics, Electromagnetism, and Modern Physics. These 50 questions make or break the Navik GD cutoff. |
| **Phase 2: Section 1 Arithmetic & General Science** | Practice 10th-level arithmetic, basic chemistry, biology, and grammar rules. Since there is no negative marking, aim to attempt all 60 questions with maximum accuracy. |
| **Phase 3: Daily Physical Fitness Routine** | Run 2 km every morning under 9 minutes. Practice 30 pushups and 40 squats daily to ensure the 10 pushups and 20 squats at the physical rally are effortless. |
| **Phase 4: Sectional Mock Tests** | Solve 25 full-length mock tests under 45-minute and 30-minute strict timers to handle the intense time constraint in CBT. |

Serving in the Indian Coast Guard combines maritime courage with cutting-edge defense technology. Prepare thoroughly for Section I and II to embark on an honorable naval career.
